استنكرا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْكَرَا (istankarā) /is.tan.ka.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اُسْتُنْكِرَا (ustunkirā) /us.tun.ki.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكِرَا (istankirā) /is.tan.ki.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
